household_invitations_active_check.name: household_invitations_active_check
household_invitations_active_check.value: ("household_invitations"."status" = 'pending' and "household_invitations"."active_member_id" is not null and "household_invitations"."active_member_id" = "household_invitations"."member_id") or ("household_invitations"."status" <> 'pending' and "household_invitations"."active_member_id" is null)

debt_change_target.name: debt_change_target
debt_change_target.value: ("debt_change_requests"."action" in ('verify_balance','edit_account','archive_account','restore_account') and "debt_change_requests"."payment_id" is null) or ("debt_change_requests"."action" in ('edit_payment','cancel_payment','confirm_payment') and "debt_change_requests"."payment_id" is not null)

debt_change_review.name: debt_change_review
debt_change_review.value: ("debt_change_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "debt_change_requests"."active_target" is not null and "debt_change_requests"."reviewed_by_user_id" is null) or ("debt_change_requests"."status" <> 'pending' and "debt_change_requests"."active_target" is null and "debt_change_requests"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null)

bill_request_review.name: bill_request_review
bill_request_review.value: ("bill_change_requests"."status"='pending' and "bill_change_requests"."active_target" is not null and "bill_change_requests"."reviewed_by_user_id" is null) or ("bill_change_requests"."status"<>'pending' and "bill_change_requests"."active_target" is null and "bill_change_requests"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null)

bill_payment_link.name: bill_payment_link
bill_payment_link.value: "bill_payments"."debt_payment_id" is null or "bill_payments"."debt_id" is not null

bill_payment_allocation.name: bill_payment_allocation
bill_payment_allocation.value: ("bill_payments"."principal_amount_cents" is null or "bill_payments"."principal_amount_cents" >= 0) and ("bill_payments"."interest_amount_cents" is null or "bill_payments"."interest_amount_cents" >= 0) and ("bill_payments"."fees_amount_cents" is null or "bill_payments"."fees_amount_cents" >= 0) and coalesce("bill_payments"."principal_amount_cents",0) + coalesce("bill_payments"."interest_amount_cents",0) + coalesce("bill_payments"."fees_amount_cents",0) <= "bill_payments"."amount_cents"

bill_period_amount.name: bill_period_amount
bill_period_amount.value: ("bill_periods"."amount_cents" is null or "bill_periods"."amount_cents" >= 0) and ("bill_periods"."estimated_amount_cents" is null or "bill_periods"."estimated_amount_cents" >= 0) and "bill_periods"."credit_cents" >= 0

bill_amount_nonnegative.name: bill_amount_nonnegative
bill_amount_nonnegative.value: ("bills"."amount_cents" is null or "bills"."amount_cents" >= 0) and ("bills"."estimated_amount_cents" is null or "bills"."estimated_amount_cents" >= 0)

bill_schedule.name: bill_schedule
bill_schedule.value: ("bills"."kind"='recurring' and "bills"."frequency" in ('weekly','biweekly','monthly','quarterly','annually') and "bills"."status" in ('active','inactive')) or ("bills"."kind"='one_time' and "bills"."frequency" is null and "bills"."linked_debt_id" is null and "bills"."end_date" is null and "bills"."status" in ('active','cancelled'))

income_source_money.name: income_source_money
income_source_money.value: ("income_sources"."hourly_rate_cents" is null or "income_sources"."hourly_rate_cents" >= 0) and ("income_sources"."expected_gross_cents" is null or "income_sources"."expected_gross_cents" >= 0) and ("income_sources"."expected_net_cents" is null or "income_sources"."expected_net_cents" >= 0)

income_confirmation.name: income_confirmation
income_confirmation.value: "income_transactions"."status" <> 'confirmed' or ("income_transactions"."actual_net_cents" is not null and "income_transactions"."deposit_date" is not null and "income_transactions"."confirmed_at" is not null and "income_transactions"."receipt_confirmed" = 1)

income_work_period.name: income_work_period
income_work_period.value: ("income_transactions"."work_period_start" is null and "income_transactions"."work_period_end" is null) or ("income_transactions"."work_period_start" is not null and "income_transactions"."work_period_end" >= "income_transactions"."work_period_start")

income_transaction_money.name: income_transaction_money
income_transaction_money.value: ("income_transactions"."actual_net_cents" is null or "income_transactions"."actual_net_cents" >= 0) and ("income_transactions"."actual_gross_cents" is null or "income_transactions"."actual_gross_cents" >= 0) and ("income_transactions"."deductions_cents" is null or "income_transactions"."deductions_cents" >= 0) and ("income_transactions"."hourly_rate_cents" is null or "income_transactions"."hourly_rate_cents" >= 0) and ("income_transactions"."expected_net_cents" is null or "income_transactions"."expected_net_cents" >= 0) and ("income_transactions"."expected_gross_cents" is null or "income_transactions"."expected_gross_cents" >= 0) and ("income_transactions"."estimated_gross_cents" is null or "income_transactions"."estimated_gross_cents" >= 0)

trading_limits.name: trading_limits
trading_limits.value: ("trading_accounts"."tier_cents" is null or "trading_accounts"."tier_cents" >= 0) and ("trading_accounts"."maximum_loss_cents" is null or "trading_accounts"."maximum_loss_cents" >= 0) and ("trading_accounts"."daily_loss_cents" is null or "trading_accounts"."daily_loss_cents" >= 0)

trading_payout_money.name: trading_payout_money
trading_payout_money.value: "trading_payouts"."requested_cents" > 0 and ("trading_payouts"."approved_cents" is null or "trading_payouts"."approved_cents" >= 0) and ("trading_payouts"."received_cents" is null or "trading_payouts"."received_cents" >= 0)

trading_payout_receipt.name: trading_payout_receipt
trading_payout_receipt.value: ("trading_payouts"."status" = 'paid' and "trading_payouts"."received_cents" is not null and "trading_payouts"."deposit_date" is not null and "trading_payouts"."income_transaction_id" is not null and "trading_payouts"."receipt_confirmed" = 1) or ("trading_payouts"."status" <> 'paid' and "trading_payouts"."received_cents" is null and "trading_payouts"."deposit_date" is null and "trading_payouts"."income_transaction_id" is null and "trading_payouts"."receipt_confirmed" = 0)

budget_scope_valid.name: budget_scope_valid
budget_scope_valid.value: ("budget_months"."responsible_member_id" is null and "budget_months"."scope_key" = 'household') or ("budget_months"."responsible_member_id" is not null and "budget_months"."scope_key" = "budget_months"."responsible_member_id")

valuation_cents.name: valuation_cents
valuation_cents.value: "asset_valuations"."value_cents" is null or ("asset_valuations"."value_cents" between -9007199254740991 and 9007199254740991 and cast("asset_valuations"."value_cents" as integer)="asset_valuations"."value_cents")

asset_purchase_cents.name: asset_purchase_cents
asset_purchase_cents.value: "assets"."purchase_cents" is null or ("assets"."purchase_cents" >= 0 and "assets"."purchase_cents" <= 9007199254740991 and cast("assets"."purchase_cents" as integer)="assets"."purchase_cents")

bank_mask_length.name: bank_mask_length
bank_mask_length.value: "bank_accounts"."mask" is null or length("bank_accounts"."mask") between 1 and 4

bank_link_kind.name: bank_link_kind
bank_link_kind.value: ("bank_accounts"."asset_id" is null or "bank_accounts"."type"<>'credit_card') and ("bank_accounts"."debt_id" is null or "bank_accounts"."type"='credit_card')

bank_current_safe.name: bank_current_safe
bank_current_safe.value: ("bank_balance_observations"."current_cents" is null or "bank_balance_observations"."current_cents" between -9007199254740991 and 9007199254740991) and ("bank_balance_observations"."current_cents" is null or cast("bank_balance_observations"."current_cents" as integer)="bank_balance_observations"."current_cents")

bank_available_safe.name: bank_available_safe
bank_available_safe.value: ("bank_balance_observations"."available_cents" is null or "bank_balance_observations"."available_cents" between -9007199254740991 and 9007199254740991) and ("bank_balance_observations"."available_cents" is null or cast("bank_balance_observations"."available_cents" as integer)="bank_balance_observations"."available_cents")

bank_transaction_amount.name: bank_transaction_amount
bank_transaction_amount.value: ("bank_transactions"."amount_cents"<>0 and "bank_transactions"."amount_cents" between -9007199254740991 and 9007199254740991) and ("bank_transactions"."amount_cents" is null or cast("bank_transactions"."amount_cents" as integer)="bank_transactions"."amount_cents")

bank_reconcile_target.name: bank_reconcile_target
bank_reconcile_target.value: (case when "bank_reconciliations"."expense_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)+(case when "bank_reconciliations"."income_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)+(case when "bank_reconciliations"."debt_payment_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)+(case when "bank_reconciliations"."bill_payment_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)+(case when "bank_reconciliations"."refund_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)+(case when "bank_reconciliations"."transfer_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)=(case when "bank_reconciliations"."classification"='ignore' then 0 else 1 end)

bank_refund_allocation_amount.name: bank_refund_allocation_amount
bank_refund_allocation_amount.value: ("bank_refund_allocations"."amount_cents">0 and "bank_refund_allocations"."amount_cents"<=9007199254740991) and ("bank_refund_allocations"."amount_cents" is null or cast("bank_refund_allocations"."amount_cents" as integer)="bank_refund_allocations"."amount_cents")

bank_refund_parent.name: bank_refund_parent
bank_refund_parent.value: (case when "bank_refunds"."expense_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)+(case when "bank_refunds"."bill_payment_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)+(case when "bank_refunds"."debt_payment_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)=1

bank_refund_amount.name: bank_refund_amount
bank_refund_amount.value: ("bank_refunds"."amount_cents">0 and "bank_refunds"."amount_cents"<=9007199254740991) and ("bank_refunds"."amount_cents" is null or cast("bank_refunds"."amount_cents" as integer)="bank_refunds"."amount_cents")

payroll_line_money.name: payroll_line_money
payroll_line_money.value: ("payroll_lines"."current_cents" is null or (abs("payroll_lines"."current_cents")<=9007199254740991 and cast("payroll_lines"."current_cents" as integer)="payroll_lines"."current_cents")) and ("payroll_lines"."ytd_cents" is null or (abs("payroll_lines"."ytd_cents")<=9007199254740991 and cast("payroll_lines"."ytd_cents" as integer)="payroll_lines"."ytd_cents"))
